text:
Just got time and opportunity to write the review… but I’ve been to this clinic (loyally) for more than 5 years (since i was in Uni and now all grown up😂)
.
Dr. Ton is very knowledgeable in his work and so honest in what he does. I’ve never got up-sale from them, which is rare in Thai’s aesthetic industry. Plus he’s been more than a Doctor to us🩷 I , my friends and my sister all come to this clinic only and only here.

Skin treatment + acne : I used to have a lot of breakout due to bad pollution in Chiang Mai and get over it because of him
Meso fat : result proved! The area got smaller in just a few days after the treatment
Botox : the botox this clinic chooses is from USA, very qualified and result proved as well! Ive done both on my forehead (to stop the wrinkle 😂) and v lift on the edge of my face
Laser for unequal skin tone : ive been doing it from the beginning to treat my acne dark spot. The result was great and ive ever got better smooth skin after.
SMAZ : BEST THING TO DO! My face got lifted up like never before. Definitely recommend 🩷

text: This is number one for acne treatment in Chiang Mai! Usually, at other places, staff just squeeze the pimples for you, but here the doctor does everything herself. She's incredibly meticulous, removing every single pimple. Importantly, the doctor is incredibly gentle; pimple extraction and injections are painless and don't leave any bruising. The staff are also very attentive and don't push you to buy treatment packages. Consultations here are incredibly relaxing. If you're looking for a great acne treatment place, I highly recommend this one!

Highly recommend! 💖💖💖
